notes: Next, lexical and syntactic passives differ in their choice of a completed/perfective aspect auxiliary. There are two perfective auxiliaries which are derived from lexical verbs whose lexical meanings are lost when they are used as functional elements: intransitive xaal ‘remain’ for intransitives (37a) and transitive kebis ‘throw, hurl’ for transitives (37b). The auxiliaries precede the main verb which appears in the anterior gerund form.
